title: TensorBEM unified flexural-gravity + mass-loading dispersion
model: omega^2 = (g k + D k^5/rho_w) tanh(kH) / (1 + mu k tanh(kH))

V2_short_wave_limit.description: kH>>1, Dk^4>>gk: omega^2 -> D k^5/(rho_w + rho_i h k)

V3_long_wave_shallow_limit.description: kH -> 0: omega^2 -> g H k^2/(1 + mu H k^2) (shallow mass-loading)

V4_ice_module_consistency.description: eq.(3) with E->0 equals tensorbem.ice mass-loading omega on k in [1e-4,0.1]

V5_crossover_wavenumber.description: k_c = (g mu/a)^(1/3) vs independent bisection of c(k)=c_open(k)

V6_group_velocity.description: cg = (N'D - ND')/D^2 /(2 omega) vs 4th-order-free central difference

V7_wavenumber_round_trip.description: omega -> k -> omega round trip, omega in [1e-2, 31.6] rad/s

V8_ice_edge_energy.description: |R|^2 + |T|^2 = 1 at the ice edge with eq.(3) wavenumbers

V9_inertia_correction_bound.description: max |inertia correction| over E in {1,5,10,20,30} GPa, h in {0.5,1,2} m, f in 0.02..0.30 Hz stays below 10%

V10_e5_arbitration.description: sign(lambda_ice/lambda_open - 1) == sign(f - f_c) for every case; f_c = omega_eq3(k_c)/2pi

V11_fd_depth_factor.description: independent FD route (discretised psi''=k^2 psi, no analytic tanh) reproduces eq.(3): finest-grid |d omega^2|/omega^2 < 1e-6 while the truncation-dominated coarse pair shows second-order convergence (observed order in [1.7, 2.3])

V12_energy_balance.description: variational energy balance (quadrature depth integral) is satisfied by eq.(3) and rejects the denominator-only variant by >1% in shallow water

V13_bem_depth_factor.description: independent boundary-integral route (periodic strip BEM for Lambda=(dphi/dz)/phi, no analytic tanh, no grid derivative) reproduces eq.(3): at 64 panels/wavelength |d omega^2|/omega^2 < 2e-3, the error decreases monotonically under refinement (overall slope 1.0-2.2), the exact-Lambda rewriting is an identity to roundoff, and the driven-Rayleigh-quotient / DtN routes agree
